title: Use custom values in templates
blurb: Drop your saved details into emails, texts and pages.

steps.title: Open Settings
steps.body: Click **Settings** at the bottom of the left menu.

steps.title: Open Custom Values
steps.body: Click **Custom Values** in the Settings menu.

steps.title: Copy the key
steps.body: Find the value and copy its key. It looks like {{custom_values.google_review_link}}.

steps.title: Paste into a template
steps.body: Open an email, text template or workflow message and paste the key where the detail should go.

steps.title: Or pick it from a menu
steps.body: Most editors have a merge field or custom value button. In workflows you can also type / to search.

steps.title: Update once
steps.body: If the detail changes, edit the value here and every template picks up the new one.
